test: causal brown leaf marker versus measured lower-rung WWV abnormality
status: diagnostic association test; not a predictor and not causal proof

strict_causal_checklist.leaf_marker: existing causal harmonic marker from NINO values at or before origin
strict_causal_checklist.wwv_baseline: training-only AR baseline using prior WWV values at lags 1,2,3,6
strict_causal_checklist.scored_outcomes: measured future WWV residual magnitudes; used only after markers exist
strict_causal_checklist.wrong_time_null: same causal leaf marker delayed 30 months
strict_causal_checklist.timing_control_panel: same causal marker delayed only backward in time by (6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54, 60, 72) months
